value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for 1 (walking) to 3 years with a parent/caregiver, fall term Sept 14 - Nov 1, with slots including Mon 9:30, Tue 10:15, and Sat 9:15 - their site says, though I could not pin down the price or registration details.
